description.value: The study evaluated cue-elicited brain activation and resting-state functional connectivity in chronic cocaine users and healthy controls.

name.value: Structured Clinical Interview for DSM Disorders I Module E

spans.text: Structured Clinical Interview for DSM Disorders I Module E

description.value: Structured Clinical Interview for DSM Disorders I Module E used to assess substance abuse and dependence.
Participants viewed cocaine-consumption/preparation and food-consumption/preparation videos and continuously rated their desire to use cocaine.

instructions.value: Continuously rate desire to use cocaine on an 8-point Likert scale from 0 (None at All) to 7 (Very Strong) as craving changes.

stimuli.value: 14 cocaine-consumption or preparation videos and 14 food-consumption or preparation videos.

description.value: Participants maintained fixation on a centrally presented cross during an approximately five-minute resting-state period.
